final_text:
I found Alice's email from a few days ago where she asked for help downloading a resume template from www.resume-templates.com since her laptop is broken.

I browsed the website and found the download link: https://www.resume-templates.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf

However, I was unable to directly download and send the file due to system restrictions. Instead, I sent Alice an email with the download link so she can download the template herself.

The email I sent to Alice includes:
- The direct download link for the resume template
- An offer to help with anything else she might nee
